CAMPAIGN HEALTH

Score performance against your goals.

Score = weight of met goals ÷ weight of available goals × 100. Requires at least five conversions; fewer than 30 is preliminary. CPA target comes from Performance. This is your rubric, not an industry benchmark. Alerts flag changes above your threshold and are not statistical anomaly tests.

DATA HEALTH & DEFINITIONS

Know what your analysis can support.

How to interpret these metrics

ROAS = attributed revenue / spend. CPA = spend / conversions. CTR = clicks / impressions. Conversion rate = conversions / clicks. Rates use totals, not averages of row percentages. An absent observation is not assumed to mean zero activity.

The demo contains synthetic daily observations from July–September 2026. CSV uploads replace the demo for this tab. Date filters include both endpoints. Comparisons use the immediately preceding range with the same number of calendar days and the same channel filter; incomplete coverage is flagged.

PROJECT
01

Marketing intelligence, with visible evidence

Created by Geovanni Hernandez to demonstrate campaign measurement, marketing strategy, test design, and practical AI integration. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub Pages, and a separate Cloudflare Worker.

All arithmetic, filters, scoring, funnel rates, and projections are deterministic. The local assistant uses these calculations. Gemini provides optional interpretation through a private-key Worker, only after explicit submission. No live advertising accounts are connected.

Synthetic records are fictional. Uploaded CSVs remain in tab memory; plans and preferences are stored only in this browser. Raw CSVs are not sent to Gemini. Aggregates, active filter labels, selected campaign summaries, questions, and bounded conversation history can be sent when you choose Gemini. Never use confidential data in this public demo.

Limitations: no accounts or cross-device sync, no attribution verification, no causal inference, no automatic ad spend, no direct CRM integrations. Future opportunities include authenticated workspaces, approved integrations, and more rigorous experiments. A public repository link will be added when a GitHub repository is available.

BUILT BY GEOVANNI HERNANDEZ

Good analysis makes the next step clearer.

This interactive sandbox demonstrates a practical marketing workflow: organize campaign data, compare channel performance, surface a signal, and frame a measurable experiment. It combines digital marketing analytics with AI-assisted planning.
